- Part 2 · [firm-07](jobs/firm/firm-07/index.html) — Write down where it is kept, why you need it, and who can open it

- Part 4 · [firm-21](jobs/firm/firm-21/index.html) — Check your own laptop and phone for customer data — never forward it on personal WhatsApp
- Part 5 · [firm-22](jobs/firm/firm-22/index.html) — Website firm signs the data agreement

- Part 6 · [firm-26](jobs/firm/firm-26/index.html) — Publish how people can ask to see, correct or delete their data
- Part 6 · [firm-27](jobs/firm/firm-27/index.html) — Answer every complaint within 90 days — within one month under today’s law
- Part 6 · [firm-28](jobs/firm/firm-28/index.html) — Delete a customer’s data when they ask or when it is no longer needed — and tell anyone you shared it with
- Part 7 · [firm-29](jobs/firm/firm-29/index.html) — Owner confirms all the answers are true
- Part 7 · [firm-30](jobs/firm/firm-30/index.html) — CA manager checks the proof
- Part 7 · [firm-31](jobs/firm/firm-31/index.html) — CA partner signs the file
